title: VALUE LEAKAGE: AN LLM'S ANSWERS ARE SILENTLY SHAPED BY ITS OWN VALUES
reasoning: The paper investigates 'value leakage,' which includes evaluating moral bias in LLMs. Specifically, it introduces a 'Donation Bet' task to measure if models covertly alter their answers to favor morally good outcomes, such as ensuring a donation goes to a good cause rather than a bad one.
